dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep V-shape profile with the vertex pointing towards the posterior lumbar region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness at the lateral shoulder regions, narrowing significantly as it converges at the dorsal midline.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation distance between the two black ear masses, occupied by white cranial fur pixels.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, rounded upper boundaries with slight lateral tapering.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant area of apparent fur loss or thinning on the lower dorsal region, characterized by a transition from white/cream fur to a darker, greyish-brown skin or undercoat exposure.
